11 /-!
12 # Darts in graphs
13 
14 A `Dart` or half-edge or bond in a graph is an ordered pair of adjacent vertices, regarded as an
15 oriented edge. This file defines darts and proves some of their basic properties.
16 -/
17 
18 @[expose] public section
19 
20 namespace SimpleGraph
21 
22 variable {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V)
23 
24 /-- A `Dart` is an oriented edge, implemented as an ordered pair of adjacent vertices.
25 This terminology comes from combinatorial maps, and they are also known as "half-edges"
26 or "bonds." -/
27 structure Dart extends V × V where
28   adj : G.Adj fst snd
29   deriving DecidableEq
30 
31 initialize_simps_projections Dart (+toProd, -fst, -snd)
32 
33 attribute [simp] Dart.adj
34 
35 variable {G}
36 
37 theorem Dart.ext_iff (d₁ d₂ : G.Dart) : d₁ = d₂ ↔ d₁.toProd = d₂.toProd := by
38   cases d₁; cases d₂; simp
39 
40 @[ext]
41 theorem Dart.ext (d₁ d₂ : G.Dart) (h : d₁.toProd = d₂.toProd) : d₁ = d₂ :=
42   (Dart.ext_iff d₁ d₂).mpr h
43 
44 @[simp]
45 theorem Dart.fst_ne_snd (d : G.Dart) : d.fst ≠ d.snd :=
46   fun h ↦ G.irrefl (h ▸ d.adj)
47 
48 @[simp]
49 theorem Dart.snd_ne_fst (d : G.Dart) : d.snd ≠ d.fst :=
50   fun h ↦ G.irrefl (h ▸ d.adj)
51 
52 theorem Dart.toProd_injective : Function.Injective (Dart.toProd : G.Dart → V × V) :=
53   Dart.ext
54 
55 instance Dart.fintype [Fintype V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] : Fintype G.Dart :=
56   Fintype.ofEquiv (Σ v, G.neighborSet v)
57     { toFun := fun s => ⟨(s.fst, s.snd), s.snd.property⟩
58       invFun := fun d => ⟨d.fst, d.snd, d.adj⟩ }
59 
60 /-- The edge associated to the dart. -/
61 def Dart.edge (d : G.Dart) : Sym2 V := s(d.fst, d.snd)
62 
63 @[simp]
64 theorem Dart.edge_mk {p : V × V} (h : G.Adj p.1 p.2) : (Dart.mk p h).edge = s(p.1, p.2) :=
65   rfl
66 
67 @[simp]
68 theorem Dart.edge_mem (d : G.Dart) : d.edge ∈ G.edgeSet :=
69   d.adj
70 
71 /-- The dart with reversed orientation from a given dart. -/
72 @[simps]
73 def Dart.symm (d : G.Dart) : G.Dart :=
74   ⟨d.toProd.swap, G.symm d.adj⟩
75 
76 @[simp]
77 theorem Dart.symm_mk {p : V × V} (h : G.Adj p.1 p.2) : (Dart.mk p h).symm = Dart.mk p.swap h.symm :=
78   rfl
79 
80 @[simp]
81 theorem Dart.edge_symm (d : G.Dart) : d.symm.edge = d.edge :=
82   Sym2.eq_swap
83 
84 @[simp]
85 theorem Dart.edge_comp_symm : Dart.edge ∘ Dart.symm = (Dart.edge : G.Dart → Sym2 V) :=
86   funext Dart.edge_symm
87 
88 @[simp]
89 theorem Dart.symm_symm (d : G.Dart) : d.symm.symm = d :=
90   Dart.ext _ _ <| Prod.swap_swap _
91 
92 @[simp]
93 theorem Dart.symm_involutive : Function.Involutive (Dart.symm : G.Dart → G.Dart) :=
94   Dart.symm_symm
95 
96 theorem Dart.symm_ne (d : G.Dart) : d.symm ≠ d :=
97   ne_of_apply_ne (Prod.snd ∘ Dart.toProd) d.adj.ne
98 
99 theorem dart_edge_eq_iff : ∀ d₁ d₂ : G.Dart, d₁.edge = d₂.edge ↔ d₁ = d₂ ∨ d₁ = d₂.symm := by
100   rintro ⟨p, hp⟩ ⟨q, hq⟩
101   simp
102 
103 theorem dart_edge_eq_mk'_iff :
104     ∀ {d : G.Dart} {u v : V}, d.edge = s(u, v) ↔ d.toProd = (u, v) ∨ d.toProd = (v, u) := by
105   rintro ⟨p, h⟩ _ _
106   simp
107 
108 theorem dart_edge_eq_mk'_iff' :
109     ∀ {d : G.Dart} {u v : V},
110       d.edge = s(u, v) ↔ d.fst = u ∧ d.snd = v ∨ d.fst = v ∧ d.snd = u := by
111   rintro ⟨⟨a, b⟩, h⟩ u v
112   rw [dart_edge_eq_mk'_iff]
113   simp
114 
115 variable (G)
116 
117 /-- Two darts are said to be adjacent if they could be consecutive
118 darts in a walk -- that is, the first dart's second vertex is equal to
119 the second dart's first vertex. -/
120 def DartAdj (d d' : G.Dart) : Prop :=
121   d.snd = d'.fst
122 
123 /-- For a given vertex `v`, this is the bijective map from the neighbor set at `v`
124 to the darts `d` with `d.fst = v`. -/
125 @[simps]
126 def dartOfNeighborSet (v : V) (w : G.neighborSet v) : G.Dart :=
127   ⟨(v, w), w.property⟩
128 
129 theorem dartOfNeighborSet_injective (v : V) : Function.Injective (G.dartOfNeighborSet v) :=
130   fun e₁ e₂ h =>
131   Subtype.ext <| by
132     injection h with h'
133     convert congr_arg Prod.snd h'
134 
135 instance nonempty_dart_top [Nontrivial V] : Nonempty (⊤ : SimpleGraph V).Dart := by
136   obtain ⟨v, w, h⟩ := exists_pair_ne V
137   exact ⟨⟨(v, w), h⟩⟩
138 
139 end SimpleGraph
